Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; I attached a short contact matrix and our SIG write-up for the incident section.

- Certified maximum notification window: 72 hours from detection for confirmed breaches that impact customer data; this is our contractual target for Dedicated/Private customers who have selected breach notification SLA.
- Typical timeline: initial triage and customer-notification decision within 24–48 hours; follow-up detailed notice (root cause + mitigation steps) typically within 5–10 business days depending on scope.
- Primary POC: Hannah Schmitt, Head of Security Operations (hannah.schmitt@redwood.com). If Hannah is unavailable, escalation is to Vivek Kulkarni (VP, Security & Compliance) and then to Monica Patel (Director, Customer Security).
- International routing: we have a central incident response team that coordinates with regional DPOs. For EU-impacting incidents we notify the regional DPO within 24 hours of the decision to notify customers.

See attached: IR_contact_matrix_v1.xlsx (contact + escalation steps) and redwood_SIG_answers_v2.pdf (SIG incident section with timelines and evidence references).

Let me know if you want these points expanded for legal.

Best,
